title: Rejected canonical JSON input test vector
description: Format of test-vectors/canonical-json-invalid/*.json. The input bytes are given as exactly one of: input_text (raw JSON text, kept as a string so that the vector file's own parser cannot normalise it; encode it as UTF-8 to get the bytes), input_base64 (raw bytes, for inputs that are not valid UTF-8), or input_generated (prefix + repeat * count + suffix, UTF-8; for inputs too large to store). operation says what is attempted: canonicalize, or object_hash (which also checks kind and a stored hash). An implementation must refuse and report the error category expected_error (docs/canonical-json.md, section 5). Each vector contains exactly one violation.

expected_kind.description: object_hash only: the kind the verifier expects at this position; a different kind is INVALID_KIND.
